", "replace": "from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Metric(BaseModel):
    name: str
    # Numeric when it parses as an int, otherwise a label (e.g. "n/a").
    value: Union[int, str] = Field(union_mode="left_to_right")
", "explanation": "Pydantic v2 defaults to smart union mode, which keeps the string "42" as str because it matches str exactly. v1 tried members left to right and coerced to int. Setting union_mode='left_to_right' restores that behavior, so numeric strings become ints. The Field import already exists and is now used. The search starts at the import line so the edit stays in scope."}], "notes": "The model_validate migration on line 14 was correct and is unchanged.
